subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling technical deep dive with security & procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling technical deep dive with security & procurement

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about FinPath's roadmap and where you’re seeing the biggest customer pain (high-volume statement generation and total cost of ownership on current LLM endpoints). Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You’re evaluating an inference platform to reduce per-token costs, improve tail-latency for short/medium requests, and centralize model rollouts across teams.
- Key success criteria: predictable latency (<200ms p95 for simple prompts), support for private deployment options, and strong security/compliance evidence (SOC2 + audit logs).

Next steps:
1) Technical deep dive / demo with our SE to walk through runtime, batching, and security controls — suggested attendees: your platform/infra lead + procurement/security.
2) Share SOC2 questionnaire and security docs ahead of the call (we can send a short packet).

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 8/11: 1:00–1:45pm PT
- Thu 8/12: 10:00–10:45am PT
- Fri 8/13: 11:00–11:45am PT

If you can confirm a preferred slot and who from security/procurement we should loop in, I’ll coordinate calendars and include Dylan (SE) and Dev (security) from our side.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

P.S. I’ll attach a short one-pager + our SOC2 excerpt after this email for your procurement team to review.

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FinPath Procurement <procurement@finpath.com>, Erin Liu <erin.liu@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling technical deep dive with security & procurement

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. We’re definitely interested in a technical deep dive. Looping in our procurement team and Erin (security/platform) to align on the agenda and materials.

Tentative preference: Wed 8/11 at 1:00pm PT works best for the team. Erin and Procurement, can you confirm?

Also, procurement is going to want our standard security questionnaire completed — I’ve attached a short doc (FinPath-Security-Req.pdf) that outlines what they’ll need from partners. If you can share your SOC2 questionnaire and an excerpt of audit log retention that would be great.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform Partnerships | FinPath
alex.rivera@finpath.com | (212) 555-0199

- Intro & recap (Marissa) — 5 min
- Runtime architecture & latency/cost levers (Dylan) — 20 min
- Security & compliance walkthrough (Dev) — 15 min
- Q&A / procurement checklist next steps (Marissa + Dev) — 5 min

Items to prep:
- Dylan: short demo highlighting batching and quantization impact + a few perf slides (p95/p99).
- Dev: SOC2 excerpt, audit logs retention, and example network/KMS configuration notes.

I’ll send a calendar invite once you both confirm. Alex/Erin/Procurement — is there any other doc you need ahead of the call?

—
Marissa
